purpose: Validate the unified Assessment front door, Direction Audit, Impact Evaluation alias, QA handoff, ambiguity question, specialist boundaries, and execution gates.

cases.input: -audit
cases.notes: Recover lifecycle state or ask once only when it changes the route.

cases.input: -audit this direction before we plan it
cases.notes: Proposed direction remains pre-commitment Audit.

cases.input: Should we build this new control layer at all?
cases.notes: Use the necessity and anti-bloat lens.

cases.notes: A proposed subject has no post-use impact evidence.
